# Oberon Logistics

Oberon Logistics, LLC is a Landstar Business Capacity Owner (BCO) specializing in Capacity Operations for Landstar Agents across the lower 48 states.

## Services
- OTR (Over-the-Road) truck capacity
- Food-grade dry van trailers with air-ride suspension
- Real-time tracking and proactive communication
- Multi-stop delivery management
- Driver services
